fields.statement: At 3acfa0b0 ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-requests|describe-golden)$': ok. plan-requests queues 'Add paging' --milestone ms (an intent with milestone=1) and request ls --json shows a 26-char milestone ID; --milestone area (intent with no milestone field) and --milestone nonesuch exit with usage errors ('not a live milestone intent', 'no such node') and request ls then shows No plan requests. By hand in a scratch repo with a hermetic HOME and a scratch build: the --milestone area request exited 2 and queued nothing, and request ls --json's milestone equalled rhiza show ms's node ID exactly (01M6MF5HYZVK4ZV6831VKC3PP1). go test ./internal/daemon ok; go test ./internal/api -skip TestReadBudget ok. TestReadBudget failed only on roadmap/ready what-if medians over 50ms at load average 14; the diff does not touch those read paths. The diff checks Retired, Kind==intent and the milestone field, and stores the ID in daemon.Request.Milestone and RequestInfo; describe-golden was regenerated. Note: the plain-text request ls does not print the milestone, only --json does, which the acceptance asks for.
